packageRules.description: Stay on one stable Home Assistant minor line (currently 2026.9): test against what users actually run, never a beta. pytest-homeassistant-custom-component is capped alongside it because it pins homeassistant exactly and starts targeting the next minor's betas before that minor is stable; 0.13.367 is the release pinning 2026.9.4. When a newer 2026.9.x patch ships, raise the phacc cap to the release pinning it. Move both caps to the next line together once its .0 is stable and a phacc pinning it exists.

Keep CI on Python 3.14 until Home Assistant supports 3.15: at the hacs.json floor, orjson, Pillow, pydantic-core and fastuuid have no 3.15 wheels and fail to build from source, so the floor job cannot install. Lift once HA (and the floor's pins) ship 3.15 wheels. Matched by packageName: for setup-python's python-version input Renovate reports depName "python" but packageName "actions/python-versions", and matchPackageNames does not fall back to depName.

Open a single PR for every dependency update (Dependabot version updates are disabled in favour of this). It must stay the last rule so no earlier groupName splits a package out. It also keeps the home-assistant test stack together: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins homeassistant, pytest and syrupy exactly, so bumping one alone is an unresolvable conflict.
